target: Anclaje geográfico visible del ramal A de la Senda del Viento Bajo.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Excavación antigua de poca profundidad y origen ordinario; puede ser futura zona peligrosa, pero ahora solo debe mostrar el exterior conocido.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior view of Cantera Abandonada beside the Korven–Edran route. A shallow old extraction cut bites into a low rock face, with plain tool-scarred stone, a rough access slope and scattered inert stone blocks. Vegetation and dust show long disuse. It should read as ordinary historical quarrying, not a mine complex, and no deeper interior is visible. The surrounding terrain is beginning to open toward Edran.
negative_constraints: No deep mine tunnel or underground interior
No cranes, modern machinery or intact industrial equipment
No monsters, corpses, treasure or boss foreshadowing
No mysterious ancient civilization, runes or magic
No characters or creatures as focal subject
notes: Fiel al anclaje geográfico canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto ni mecánica.
